record.fact_text: To be put on payroll in Spain you need a Social Security number (Número de la Seguridad Social, NUSS) — the number that identifies you to Social Security, also called the affiliation number (NAF). It is requested with your DNI/NIE.
record.evidence_quote: El Número de la Seguridad Social (NUSS) es el número con el que la Seguridad Social te identifica. También se conoce como Número de Afiliación (NAF).

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: the employer handles all Social Security paperwork. Actually: you must have a NUSS before you can be registered (alta) as a worker, and requesting it already requires a DNI or NIE. Action required: get your NIE first, then request the NUSS.
